The air was thick with the scent of salt and diesel, a familiar perfume that clung to their clothes and hair. They had worked all day, hoisting containers onto the waiting ships, their muscles aching from the repetitive motion. Now, they were tired, but not defeated. They had a rhythm to their lives, a cadence that matched the tides.
